subject.why: The roller skates are immediately recognizable, complete with wheels, trucks, stoppers, and the requested pink pom-poms on the laces.

category.why: The skates float in the air with a slight tilt against a vibrant green background featuring radiating rays, fully adhering to category 1.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The pair of skates is nicely centered with generous margins on all sides and nothing cropped.

colour.why: The color scheme is bright and saturated, with the white and pink skates popping distinctly against the lime green background.

detail.why: The asset maintains clean, chunky forms without micro-textures, fussy lace details, or unnecessary extra props.

style.why: The rendering features smooth 3D volumes, a soft satin sheen, clean lighting, and no outlines, matching the reference cards.
